title: Core Discovery Series
description: A reference-dependent four-image series that locks the visual identity of Egyptian Polychrome Wall Reconstruction and then studies scale, surface, and atmosphere from the same archaeological anchor.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the definitive site anchor for Egyptian Polychrome Wall Reconstruction; images 02-04 must preserve that exact place identity while varying human scale, close material evidence, and wider environmental context.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01 first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-04. Queue may run 02-04 concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
